targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_summary" and r._field == "total_queries")
  |> last()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_summary" and r._field == "blocked_queries")
  |> last()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_summary" and r._field == "percent_blocked")
  |> last()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_summary" and r._field == "unique_domains")
  |> last()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_summary" and r._field == "unique_clients")
  |> last()

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_summary" and (r._field == "total_queries" or r._field == "blocked_queries"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_query_types" and r._field == "count")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["type"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_top_domains" and r._field == "count")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["domain"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_top_blocked" and r._field == "count")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["domain"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dns_top_clients" and r._field == "count")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["client"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"], desc: true)
